thread:
Eli (PM): quick sync: infra flagged were hitting dedicated capacity limits if we keep current v1 scope. need to pick smallest set to keep GA date.
Ava (Eng): list of things that materially add infra: persona-routing, full per-route cost, embeddings-quant v2, dynamic autoscale windows.
Priya (Design): persona-routing is more UX polish than blocking for early customers. can do a simple selector in the UI later.
Casey (Sales): customers asking for cheaper embeddings and per-route cost visibility. both are high ask but not blockers for POC users.
Jon (SRE): telemetry ingest is the real pressure. per-route billing increases cardinality. embeddings-quant needs GPU memory tuning.
Eli (PM): propose three trade paths:
- Path 1: MVP-lite (keep core API, promptstore CRUD, minimal billing + aggregate telemetry). defer persona-routing & embeddings-quant v2 and per-route cost. GA on time.
- Path 2: Shift date +2w to include embeddings-quant v2 and per-route cost.
- Path 3: Hybrid pilot: GA with MVP-lite, enable embeddings-quant v2 + per-route cost behind admin-only pilot for 3 customers (feature-flagged). needs 1 week ops + gating.
Ava (Eng): engineering estimate: Path1 = no schedule change. Path2 = +2w and +1 sprint of testing. Path3 = +1w for gating + 1w to stabilize for pilot.
Priya (Design): UX for pilot states is simple  small modal + admin dashboard entry. I can mock in 3 days.
Casey (Sales): pilot route would let us demo full features to top deals without risking platform health. thumbs up.
Jon (SRE): pilot infra requirements: RBAC for pilot tenants, reduced telemetry sampling for pilot, canary autoscaler policy. I can own runbook; 3-5 day prep.
Eli (PM): risks: Path1 => slower cost improvements post-GA. Path2 => delays revenue and feedback. Path3 => added ops complexity but keeps GA.
Ava (Eng): downside of Path3 is extra test matrix for gated code paths but acceptable if we freeze other changes.
Priya (Design): agree Path3 preserves user experience while keeping launch momentum.
Jon (SRE): +1 to Path3. I'll prepare an emergency rollback plan for the pilot.
Casey (Sales): +1 Path3. will surface pilot tenants and sign NDAs.
Eli (PM): decision = Path3 (GA on schedule with MVP-lite; pilot for embeddings-quant + per-route cost behind admin flag to 3 tenants).
Eli (PM): action items: Ava -> plan feature-flag implementation and safety tests. Jon -> create pilot runbook + RBAC. Priya -> pilot UI mocks. Casey -> recruit 3 pilot customers and legal signoff. I'll update roadmap doc and announce to GTM.
deploy-bot: @channel milestone note: "GA schedule maintained; pilot gating for advanced infra features" recorded.
Eli (PM): thanks everyone, 15min catch-up tomorrow 11am to kick off tasks.
